signals_vocabulary.payments: Financial transactions, payment flows, money movement
signals_vocabulary.ekyc: Identity verification, eKYC, KYB, AML/CFT onboarding
signals_vocabulary.pii: Personal data / PII beyond basic profile fields

geography_note: Geographies use country codes (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), optionally with a subdivision suffix (e.g. US-CA, US-IL). GLOBAL means not geography-bound. Matching is country-level: a request for 'US' matches 'US-CA' entries and vice versa.

regulations.name: GDPR (Regulation (EU) 2016/679)
regulations.summary: General Data Protection Regulation. Lawful basis for processing, data-subject rights (access, deletion, portability), DPIAs, breach notification; Art. 9 covers biometrics, Chapter V covers cross-border transfers.

regulations.name: PSD2 (Directive (EU) 2015/2366)
regulations.summary: Revised Payment Services Directive. Strong Customer Authentication (SCA), open-banking access to accounts, licensing of payment service providers.

regulations.name: PCI-DSS
regulations.summary: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard. Controls for storing, processing, and transmitting cardholder data; scoping and network segmentation; annual assessment.

regulations.name: HIPAA
regulations.summary: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act. Privacy and Security Rules for protected health information (PHI), breach notification, Business Associate Agreements.

regulations.name: CCPA / CPRA
regulations.summary: California Consumer Privacy Act as amended by CPRA. Consumer rights to know, delete, correct, and opt out of sale/sharing; sensitive personal information category.

regulations.name: COPPA
regulations.summary: Children's Online Privacy Protection Rule. Verifiable parental consent before collecting personal data from children under 13; notice and data-minimization duties.

regulations.name: BIPA (740 ILCS 14)
regulations.summary: Illinois Biometric Information Privacy Act. Written consent before collecting biometric identifiers, retention/destruction schedule, private right of action.

regulations.name: FATF AML/CFT Recommendations
regulations.summary: International AML/CFT standards. Customer due diligence (CDD/EDD), beneficial-ownership, suspicious-transaction reporting, risk-based approach. Implemented locally by national regulators.

regulations.name: OJK POJK 12/POJK.03/2018
regulations.summary: Indonesian Financial Services Authority rule on implementation of digital banking services, including electronic CDD/eKYC obligations for banks.

regulations.name: OJK POJK 35/POJK.05/2018
regulations.summary: Indonesian Financial Services Authority rule on the business conduct of financing (multifinance) companies, including consumer-credit obligations.

regulations.name: Bank Indonesia SNAP (National Open API Payment Standard)
regulations.summary: Bank Indonesia's Standar Nasional Open API Pembayaran. Mandatory technical, security, and data standards for payment open APIs in Indonesia.

regulations.name: MAS Notice 626
regulations.summary: Monetary Authority of Singapore AML/CFT notice to banks. Customer due diligence, ongoing monitoring, and record-keeping requirements.

regulations.name: RBI Regulations (India)
regulations.summary: Reserve Bank of India directions covering payment systems, KYC Master Direction, and data-localisation of payment data within India.

regulations.name: PDPA (Singapore)
regulations.summary: Singapore Personal Data Protection Act. Consent, purpose limitation, notification, access/correction, and data-breach notification obligations.

regulations.name: PDPA (Thailand)
regulations.summary: Thailand Personal Data Protection Act. Lawful basis and consent, data-subject rights, cross-border transfer rules, breach notification.

regulations.name: UU PDP (Law No. 27 of 2022, Indonesia)
regulations.summary: Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law (Undang-Undang Perlindungan Data Pribadi No. 27/2022). Lawful processing, data-subject rights, controller/processor duties, cross-border transfer conditions.

regulations.name: PIPL (China)
regulations.summary: Personal Information Protection Law of the PRC. Separate consent for sensitive data, cross-border transfer security assessment, data-localisation for critical operators.

regulations.name: UK GDPR & Data Protection Act 2018
regulations.summary: The UK's retained GDPR together with the Data Protection Act 2018. Lawful basis, data-subject rights, ICO enforcement; separate from EU GDPR post-Brexit, with its own international-transfer regime (IDTA).

regulations.name: LGPD (Lei 13.709/2018, Brazil)
regulations.summary: Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais. Lawful bases for processing, data-subject rights, ANPD enforcement, specific consent rules for children's data, international transfer conditions.

regulations.name: DPDP Act 2023 (India)
regulations.summary: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (No. 22 of 2023). Notice-and-consent for digital personal data, data-fiduciary obligations, verifiable parental consent and no tracking/targeted ads for children, Data Protection Board of India.

regulations.name: PIPEDA (Canada)
regulations.summary: Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act. Ten fair-information principles, meaningful consent, breach reporting to the OPC, accountability for data transferred for processing.

regulations.name: Privacy Act 1988 & APPs (Australia)
regulations.summary: Privacy Act 1988 and the Australian Privacy Principles. Collection, use and disclosure limits, APP 8 cross-border disclosure accountability, Notifiable Data Breaches scheme, OAIC enforcement.
